summary: Free team chat app with channels, DMs and apps for workplace messaging.
access_note: API keys addon is available on all plans; apps with app key and user/bot tokens can be created in workspace settings.

evidence.quote: This addon lets you generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests.
The full list of available actions is available in the Swagger documentation.
With the Pumble Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, you can connect third-party AI agents (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Codex) to Pumble.

notes: Swagger docs not opened, so breadth is assumed moderate. An OAuth/app-install flow with app key plus user/bot tokens also exists per the MCP page but was not fully verified as OAuth 2.0. Rate limit 1000 req/min/user.
